visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens outdoors in a lush, green park-like setting under overcast skies. A character with short brown hair, wearing glasses, a white patterned top, and a purple scarf, stands holding a vibrant purple umbrella. The character smiles widely, looking directly at the camera with animated facial expressions and lively hand gestures. (2) The setting shifts to a small, brightly lit indoor bathroom with white tiled walls and a blue-and-orange patterned tile border. The character is sitting on a toilet, though fully clothed in the same outfit. They appear distressed, leaning forward and gesturing toward the camera with furrowed brows. (3) Within the same bathroom stall, the character suddenly opens the large purple umbrella, which nearly fills the cramped space. They look up at the ceiling and then back at the camera with a triumphant yet exaggerated expression. (4) The character sets up a black folding music stand in front of the toilet and begins playing a melodica (keyboard flute) through a flexible white tube. They sway their head to the rhythm, showing intense concentration and occasional comedic eye rolls. (5) A green lawn sprinkler attached to a yellow garden hose is placed on the floor near the toilet. The character looks down at it with anticipation. (6) High-pressure water suddenly jets upward from the rotating sprinkler, drenching the character from below. The character reacts with high energy, showing expressions of shock, pleasure, and chaotic laughter while their hair and scarf become soaked. (7) A transition occurs to an indoor office or studio setting with horizontal blinds. The character holds various boxes of "FIBHER" products, smiling and presenting them with professional endorsement gestures. They are seen drinking a green beverage from a glass. (8) The video concludes with a montage of bloopers and behind-the-scenes footage back in the bathroom and outdoors. The character is seen laughing at mistakes, interacting with off-screen crew, and adjusting their wig and costume while credits roll over the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, high-tempo synthesizer BGM with a strong, comedic four-on-the-floor beat. A high-pitched, feminine-coded male voice speaks energetically in a mix of Japanese and Mandarin, with high vocal arousal and sharp articulation. (2) A sharp mechanical 'click' and 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition as the umbrella opens. The voice becomes more strained and melodic. (3) The BGM continues as the character begins playing a melodica; the acoustic sound of the reed instrument is clear, playing a simple, jaunty melody with audible breath support. (4) A loud, continuous 'hissing' and 'splashing' sound of high-pressure water dominates the mix as the sprinkler activates. The character emits high-pitched yelps and gasping laughter, with the water noise creating a broadband frequency mask over the lower speech frequencies. (5) A hard cut occurs to a more rhythmic, 'infomercial' style electronic track with repetitive synth loops. The speaker's tone shifts to a polished, persuasive promotional delivery. (6) The final phase features 'cracking' and 'thudding' incidental noises, followed by spontaneous, low-arousal male laughter from off-screen crew members, indicating a behind-the-scenes recording environment.
